exposure: Group B: Pregnant women with medical conditions during pregnancy
Group A: Pregnant women with medical conditions before pregnancy
Group C: Pregnant women with pregnancy-related high-risk issues
cohort: 206 high-risk pregnant women at a hospital in Dhaka, Bangladesh
finding: High-risk pregnancies were associated with a higher incidence of preterm delivery, caesarean section, and low birth weight, although maternal and neonatal mortality rates were not significantly different.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 69.41% of high-risk pregnant women.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome (low birth weight), but no specific range given
